verdict.rationale: Slate is a terminal-based coding agent, and the docs describe only interactive TUI use: slash commands, hotkeys, subagent cards and an onboarding flow. Nothing documents a programmatic API that matches the UI's capabilities, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. The CLI is itself the interactive interface, not a separate API, so it earns no credit toward API-to-UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
